reference_contract: TP16 attention + EP16 routed experts, sequential CFG; alternative CP/DP separate

attention.head_owner: head h -> N_h, all 16 heads partitioned once
attention.hidden: replicated/tiled Sx2048 after collective; footprint and liveness need proof
attention.O: row shard partial -> sum collective, bias exactly once after sum
attention.norm: FP32 RMS source boundary, Q/K scale [128] shared across heads
attention.communication: QKV weights TP shards; O partial allreduce via reduce-scatter/allgather lowering; cannot add source CP all-to-alls simultaneously

expert.owner: p_l(e)=e mod16 baseline; 8 experts per rank/layer
expert.router: one FP32 decision per token at unique origin; replicated 1MiB router weight/rank candidate
expert.dispatch: send unique assignment only after actual route known; local assignment has no NoC payload
expert.combine: return owner output to token origin, restore actual Top8 slot order, FP32 multiply/sum then BF16 cast
expert.shared: replicate 9MiB shared weights per rank/layer; execute each token only at unique origin, not16 times
expert.next_layer: allgather combined joint hidden for TP attention; no allgather before completion

source_CP.type: Ulysses-style sequence/head all-to-all; 3 QKV exchanges plus1 output exchange
source_CP.candidate_degree: 4 or16 head divisors with explicit sequence padding; not selected
source_CP.relation_to_TP: alternative mutually exclusive contraction, not extra traffic added to TP16

source_DP.limitation: cannot rebatch arbitrary video tokens as independent attention sequences; total token budget and output identity preserved

memory.host_backing: capacity overlay candidate128GiB; not authorized/selected here
memory.completion: host read -> PCIe/gateway -> HB install -> validity -> SRAM DMA -> compute; no offline additive latency
memory.weights: whole model is not resident in8GiBHB; per-layer paging and tile reuse mandatory

precision.FP32_router: vector/software MAC or separately calibrated path

HiBand.type: independent reference integration, not author artifact reproduction
HiBand.phases: local/global bytes classify; static baseline first; dynamic drain/setup/switch buffers on completion paths
HiBand.scope: partition modes and HB/NoC arbitration; not bandwidth*4 logical banks

SemMoE.type: port model/data co-scheduling contract; existing alternating co-clustering is approximate
SemMoE.profile_key: sample/scene + step band + CFG branch + layer + joint token type/position embedding; unseen content correspondence unproven
SemMoE.causality: freeze placement and predictor before heldout; current realized router output usable after router only; future steps unknown
SemMoE.gate: no affinity predictor quality -> no online Sem-MoE gain claim; oracle separate
